_howto: Every film on the site comes from this file. To change a film: put the new .mp4 in /videos and two 16:9 poster JPGs in /assets/img named NAME-800.jpg and NAME-1600.jpg, set poster to /assets/img/NAME, edit the entry below, then run: node tools/build.mjs. Set featured to true for up to three films to show them on the home page. kind must be one of: client (made for a paying client), concept (a speculative film made to show an idea), study (a short visual experiment). category must be one of: brand, product, advertising, explainer, education, experiments. services lists the service pages the film appears on as an example.
